name: jerk-balance
instructions:
1. Setup with the bar in the front rack as you would for a front squat and your feet in a the split stance jerk position.
2. Dip slightly by bending the front knee and then drive up and press the bar overhead.
3. As the bar reaches lockout, move the front foot forward to mimic your jerk finish position.
4. Catch the bar overhead with elbows locked out.
5. Drop the bar back down to the shoulders.
6. Move the front foot back into the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
